info.description:
Odds-API.io is a powerful sports betting odds comparison API, providing real-time data from 365+ bookmakers across 34 sports with near zero latency.

- 365+ bookmakers supported
- 34 sports including Football, Basketball, Tennis, Esports and more
- Real-time odds with close to zero latency
- Pre-match & In-play odds coverage
- 99.9% uptime for reliability
info.title: Odds-API.io - Real-Time Sports Betting Odds API (v3)

get.description: Returns the prematch odds movements for one market line of an event from a bookmaker: the opening price, the latest price and recent price changes (how many are kept depends on the bookmaker feed). Market and bookmaker names are case-insensitive. A 404 explains what is missing and lists the markets or lines that do have history. History is recorded only for a fixed set of bookmakers: 10BET, 12bet, 1xbet, 22Bet, 888Sport, BC.Game, Bet365, Betano, Betclic FR, Betfair Exchange, Betfair Sportsbook, BetMGM, Betsson, Betway, Bovada, CloudBet, Coolbet, DraftKings, FanDuel, FB Sports, GG.bet, Goldbet IT, Kalshi, Kambi, Ladbrokes, M88, Norsk Tipping, ON Sharp, Paddy Power, Pamestoixima, Polymarket, Sbobet, Sharp Exchange, SingBet, Sisal IT, Stake, Stoiximan, Superbet, Tipico DE, Unibet, Vbet, Veikkaus, William Hill, Winamax FR, and selected sharp books. Requesting a bookmaker outside this set returns a 404.

Returns odds that have dropped significantly from their opening values. Data is pre-computed and updated every ~30 seconds. Results are sorted by the selected time window's drop percentage (descending). Pagination metadata is returned in response headers (X-Total-Count, X-Page, X-Per-Page, X-Updated-At).

**Data source selection:**
- If both `sport` and `league` are provided → reads league-specific data (all entries for that league)
- If only `sport` is provided → reads sport-level data (top 200 per sport)
- If neither → reads global data (top 500 across all sports)

**Note:** This endpoint requires a paid plan (Starter or above). Free plan users will receive a 403 error.

**Note:** `leagues` and `league` are mutually exclusive. `leagues` fetches from the sport- or global-level dataset and filters server-side.

get.description:
Maps our events and selections to a bookmaker's own identifiers, so our prices can be matched to the bookmaker's own markets. For Polymarket, `marketId` is the conditionId and `outcomeId` is the CLOB token id. For Kalshi, `marketId` is the contract ticker and `outcomeId` is `yes` or `no`. Each row carries our event's `home`, `away`, `date`, `sport` and `league`.

Modes:
- `eventId`, or `eventIds` with up to 10 ids
- `marketId`, or `marketIds` with up to 10 ids, optionally with `outcomeId`
- `outcomeId` alone
- bulk sync: `bookmaker` with none of the above. Returns every mapping for upcoming and live linked events as `{ "data": [...], "nextCursor": "..." }`. Pass `nextCursor` back as `cursor` until it is `null`.

Every mode returns `{data, nextCursor}`; `nextCursor` is null for lookups. `market` and `active` narrow every mode; `sport`, `league`, `limit` and `cursor` apply to bulk sync only. When `outcomeId` alone matches outcomes in more than one market (Kalshi outcome ids are `yes` and `no`), the request returns 400 and `marketId` must be added. `market`, `hdp` and `side` use our event's orientation, the same as `/v3/odds`. A mapping stays listed with `active: false` after the bookmaker withdraws the outcome. A batch or bulk call counts as one request. Available on paid plans; the bookmaker must be in your selection.

parameters.description: Our event id. Returns every mapping of this event.
parameters.name: eventId

parameters.description: Comma-separated list of up to 10 of our event ids. Use instead of `eventId`.
parameters.name: eventIds

parameters.description: The bookmaker's market id (Polymarket conditionId, Kalshi contract ticker). Can be combined with `outcomeId`.
parameters.name: marketId

parameters.description: Comma-separated list of up to 10 bookmaker market ids. Use instead of `marketId`; can be combined with `outcomeId`.
parameters.name: marketIds

parameters.description: The bookmaker's outcome id (Polymarket CLOB token id, Kalshi `yes` or `no`). For Kalshi, pass it together with `marketId`.
parameters.name: outcomeId

parameters.description: Only this market, by its exact name as served in `/v3/odds` (case-sensitive).
parameters.name: market

parameters.description: `true` for outcomes the bookmaker still lists, `false` for withdrawn ones. Default: both.
parameters.name: active

parameters.description: Bulk sync only: sport slug or name.
parameters.name: sport

parameters.description: Bulk sync only: league slug. Requires `sport`.
parameters.name: league

parameters.description: Bulk sync only: rows per page.
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description: Bulk sync only: the `nextCursor` of the previous page.
parameters.name: cursor

200.description: OK. data holds the mappings; nextCursor is set only in bulk sync while more pages remain.

get.description: Returns all available markets per sport. Use `shape` to parse a market's odds and `prematch`/`live` to see where it's offered. No API key required.

parameters.description: Sport name or slug (e.g. Football or football). Omit for all sports keyed by slug.
parameters.name: sport

200.description: With `sport`: markets for that sport. Without: all sports keyed by slug.

name.description: Market name, as it appears in /odds responses.

shape.description: How to parse the odds. `moneyline`: home/away (+draw on 3-way markets). `line`: one entry per line, with hdp and over/under or home/away. `outcomes`: fixed outcomes (1X/12/X2, odd/even). `yesno`: yes/no prices. `labelled`: one price per label ("2-1", "1st Half", a player name).

period.description: Which part of the event the market covers.

dto.ClockDto.description: Live match-clock state for in-play events. minute/playedSeconds are extrapolated server-side from the live feed and only advance while running is true.

running.description: Whether the clock is currently running

lastMovedAt.description: Unix milliseconds timestamp of last odds movement

updatedAt.description: Unix milliseconds timestamp of last pipeline update

expectedValueUpdatedAt.description: Last time the expected value or the sharp limit increased. Not a freshness signal.

firstSeenAt.description: When this value bet first appeared.

bookmakerOddsUpdatedAt.description: Last time this bookmaker price was written. May be absent.

label.description: Player name for player prop markets (e.g. "Carlos Baleba"). Only present on player prop entries.

1X.description:
Specialty market fields
Double Chance: 1X (home or draw), 12 (home or away), X2 (draw or away)

depthLayNo.description: Available liquidity to lay no. Yes/no markets only (currently Both Teams To Score on exchange-style books).

depthLayOver.description: Available liquidity to lay over. On yes/no markets this repeats depthLayYes, kept for compatibility.

depthLayUnder.description: Available liquidity to lay under. On yes/no markets this repeats depthLayNo, kept for compatibility.

depthLayYes.description: Available liquidity to lay yes. Yes/no markets only (currently Both Teams To Score on exchange-style books).

depthNo.description: Available liquidity to back no. Yes/no markets only (currently Both Teams To Score on exchange-style books).

depthOver.description: Available liquidity to back over. On yes/no markets this repeats depthYes, kept for compatibility.

depthUnder.description: Available liquidity to back under. On yes/no markets this repeats depthNo, kept for compatibility.

depthYes.description: Available liquidity to back yes. Yes/no markets only (currently Both Teams To Score on exchange-style books).

none.description: First Team To Score: none option

odds.description: Labeled markets (Half Time / Full Time, Correct Score) - single odds value per outcome

overs.description: Cricket only. Overs bowled by each side in this innings.

wickets.description: Cricket only. Wickets lost by each side in this innings.

dto.SideFloats.description: Home/away pair that can be fractional. Cricket overs use cricket notation: 19.3 means nineteen overs and three balls.

dto.SideInts.description: Home/away pair of whole numbers (cricket wickets).

clock.description: Live match clock (live events only; absent when no clock data is available)

createdAt.description: When the bookmaker was added to the API, in UTC (RFC3339). Absent for a small number of legacy entries.

home.description: Home team of our event, in our orientation

away.description: Away team of our event, in our orientation

label.description: Selection label for labelled markets such as player props

hdp.description: The line as /v3/odds shows it (the home handicap on a Spread). Omitted on markets without a line

nativeEventId.description: The bookmaker's event id. For Polymarket it is the same value as `bookmakerIds` in `/v3/odds`. For Kalshi it is the event ticker the contract belongs to: the game ticker (the `bookmakerIds` value) for ML, and the spread or total event ticker for those contracts.

marketId.description: The bookmaker's market id (Polymarket conditionId, Kalshi contract ticker)

outcomeId.description: The bookmaker's outcome id (Polymarket CLOB token id, Kalshi `yes` or `no`)

outcomeLabel.description: The outcome's name at the bookmaker

extra.description: Bookmaker-specific details, such as the Polymarket question

active.description: False once the bookmaker stopped listing the outcome

lastCheckedAt.description: When we last saw the outcome at the bookmaker

nextCursor.description: Pass as `cursor` to get the next page. `null` on the last page.

controllers.NativeIDMappingPage.description: Every /v3/mappings response. nextCursor is null for lookups and set in bulk sync while more pages remain.
